title: Deterministic death and respawn: client 1 is killed twice through /debug/kill
description: map_01, three clients. The enemy phase stays on because it owns the player respawn rule, but with no population (GAMESERVER_ENEMY_MAX, _MAX_PER_PLAYER, _WAVE_SIZE, _WAVE_SIZE_PER_PLAYER = 0) and enemy attacks off, so nothing else kills anyone. Client 1 walks away from the spawn, then is killed at 12 s and 27 s with POST /debug/kill (rpg-mmo-server hook S1: death through CombatResolver.ApplyDamage, respawn by the normal rule within one world interval). Graded: the respawn happened; respawn placement does not land on another player; client 1's only prediction snaps are the two respawns; remote clients draw the teleport without a jump or overshoot; no duplicate entity. Every assertion that depends on the kill is INCONCLUSIVE if the server did not confirm it (a server without the hook answers 404).

assertions.title: each confirmed kill is followed by a respawn
respawn placement does not land on another player
client 1 snaps exactly at its respawns, and nowhere else
no rendered jump beyond the server's own teleports
remote clients draw the respawned player on the server path (no overshoot)
no duplicate entity for the respawned player
